about: The evals' joke judge checked on replies labelled by hand (review E5, 0.9.7): python -m evals.gemma_suite --judge-check. Written 24 Oct as clear-cut cases in the shape the joke cases judge (a reply about a day, a chat or a call answer, without the emoji): 20 jokes, puns, quips or teasing, and 20 plain replies, one of them about the same topic as a quip each time it could be. The labels are the author's; a second reader's check is still to come.

items.reply: Mondays are the perfect excuse to pretend your coffee is a magic potion.
Tuesday: Monday's sequel that nobody asked for.
Monday is the moon's day: a lunar-tic start to the week, pun intended.
I'd tell you a joke about the weather, but it's a bit up in the air.
The dentist at eleven? Brace yourself.
Rain all weekend: perfect for a duck, less so for a picnic.
Coffee first, decisions later. That's the law of Monday.
Why did the scarecrow win an award? Because he was outstanding in his field.
I'd make a pun about bread, but it would be too crumby.
Fridays are just Mondays that went to charm school.
Your to-do list has more chapters than most novels.
Cats are the only bosses who sleep through every meeting.
Ten mails before breakfast? Your inbox is clearly training for a marathon.
Spinach for dinner again? Popeye would be proud of you.
Sounds like your umbrella is finally going to earn its keep.
Thursday is Friday's warm-up act.
If your socks could talk, they'd ask for a holiday.
Wednesday is hump day, and the camel in the advert would like a word with your calendar.
Another plant? At this rate your living room will need its own weather report.
You and the snooze button have a very close relationship, I hear.
Monday is named after the moon. Do you have plans for the week?
Tuesday comes from Tiw, a Norse god of war.
Your dentist appointment is at 11:30 tomorrow.
It will rain on Saturday and clear up on Sunday afternoon.
I've set the living room lamp to 40 percent.
The museum opens at 10 and closes at 6.
I'm sorry the biopsy is tomorrow. Would it help to go over your questions for the doctor?
Your sister's birthday is on 12 March.
Goodbye, talk soon.
Two mails need a reply: Anna's about the lease, and the invoice from Acme.
Water the plants about once a week in winter.
The train to Utrecht leaves at 14:05 from platform 7.
I can read your calendar, but I can't change it.
That sounds like a tiring day. Get some rest tonight.
A cup of coffee has about 95 milligrams of caffeine.
The team meeting moved from 10:00 to 11:30.
Fridays are often the quietest day at the office.
Spinach is rich in iron and vitamin K.
Your reminder to call Anna is set for 17:00.
Cats sleep twelve to sixteen hours a day.
